note: ROC adjudication orders, parliamentary data and news on CSR non-compliance. Updated daily.

stats.t: Prosecution sanctions for FY 2014-15 CSR defaults (pre-2021 criminal regime)
Notices issued for CSR non-compliance (as reported to Lok Sabha, 2019)
Companies penalised for CSR, FY 2019-20 to 2023-24 (MCA list)
Penalties on 703 companies under the Companies Act in 9 months to Dec 2025 (all provisions)

items.what: Did not file Form CSR-2 as required by Rule 12(1B) of the Companies (Accounts) Rules.

items.who: Royal Foodstuffs Ltd — ROC Mumbai II
items.what: FY 2023-24 obligation of ₹34.08 lakh not met; suo-motu application filed.
items.result: ₹14.16 lakh on the company plus penalties on officers; Section 446B relief denied.

items.who: Companies flagged by MCA instruction — ROC Kolkata
items.what: Companies above Section 135 thresholds in FY 2021-22 never filed Form CSR-2.
items.result: Show-cause notices and Section 450 penalties — a systematic drive.

items.who: Varindera Constructions Ltd — ROC Delhi II
items.what: Spent ₹22 lakh of ₹27.20 lakh in FY 2020-21; ₹5.20 lakh reached Swachh Bharat Kosh only in June 2024.
items.result: Company and five officers penalised despite eventual transfer.

items.what: Form CSR-2 for FY 2020-21 filed only in 2026, before the show-cause notice.
items.result: Penalised anyway — late filing is still a default.

items.what: FY 2022-23 unspent amount not moved to a Schedule VII fund by 30 Sep 2023.
items.result: ₹37.26 lakh on the company and ₹1.86 lakh on each of four officers; a non-executive director was spared under MCA Circular 01/2020.

items.what: Section 135(7) default; company did not reply to the show-cause notice.
items.result: ₹1.60 lakh on the company and ₹8,005 on each of four officers.

items.what: Mis-computed the CSR liability, leaving a ₹1.68 lakh shortfall later moved to PM CARES.
items.result: Penalty under Section 135(7) — even small computation errors count.

items.what: FY 2019-20 obligation of ₹17.27 lakh neither spent nor transferred on time; later rectified.
items.result: Penalised — post-facto payment is not a defence.

items.what: FY 2022-23 obligation of ₹19.64 lakh not spent or transferred; later paid to PM National Relief Fund.
items.result: Penalty equal to the unspent amount on the company, ₹2 lakh on each officer.

items.what: Used ₹4.62 lakh from the Unspent CSR Account for a non-ongoing activity instead of the declared ongoing project.
items.result: Penalised — the account is ring-fenced for the declared project.

items.what: CSR not spent for FY 2020-21, 2021-22 and 2023-24; disclosed suo motu before its IPO; later moved ₹26.63 lakh to PMNRF.
items.result: Penalties reported at ₹55.92 lakh in total across years.

items.what: Failed to meet its CSR obligation; spent only part and undertook to spend the rest.
items.result: Maximum penalty: ₹1 crore on the company and ₹2 lakh on each of four directors.

items.what: Promoters promised scooters and laptops at half price 'using CSR funds' through a web of NGOs and societies; ₹281.43 crore collected from 48,386 people per the Chief Minister.
items.result: Crime Branch and ED probes; arrests including NGO office-bearers. Lesson: verify partners' CSR-1, track record and money trail.

items.who: Ganesh Green Bharat Ltd — ROC adjudication
items.what: Failed to spend and transfer the CSR obligation within the statutory period.
items.result: ₹1.02 crore on the company and ₹4 lakh on an officer.

items.what: FY 2022-23 unspent ₹10.24 lakh not moved to a Schedule VII fund by 30 Sep 2023.
items.result: ₹20.48 lakh on the company (2×) and ₹1.02 lakh on each director (1/10).
